Command-line reference

dlsurfer <command> [options]

Commands

Command

Purpose

doctor

Dependency / READY check

smoke

Doctor + dry-run core-lesion

gates

List production gates

run

Build/execute a profile plan

engines

Engine registry (--alternatives)

atlases

Atlas notes

compare

FS vs FastSurfer matrix

gaps-remaining

Gaps without DL alts

cite

Citation boilerplate for a profile

handoff

Print-only consumer notes

bids-app

BIDS App–style stub (bids_dir output_dir level) — status

run — important flags

Flag

Meaning

--profile

Profile id (required)

--t1

T1 NIfTI (required)

--sd / --sid

SUBJECTS_DIR / subject

--fs-license

FreeSurfer license

--lesion-mask

For lesion profiles

--device

auto / cpu / cuda

--threads

Thread count

--batch-size

FastSurfer --batch

--viewagg-device

FastSurfer view aggregation device

--atlas

Labeling scheme (default DKT)

--no-cc / --no-cereb / --no-hypothal

Module offs

--vox-size

FastSurfer voxel size

--hpc

srun / brun

--execute

Actually run

--allow-experimental

Override open gates

 
dlsurfer run --help
